name: ue5-codex-studio
description: Foundation workflows for structured Unreal Engine 5 game development in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, and validate UE5 games in Codex.
interface.longDescription: An early UE5 Codex Studio foundation. It supports zero-idea, narrative, design-pack, and existing-project intake plus traceable design, production, QA, release, and operations workflows. Editor automation remains experimental and disabled until explicit secure provisioning succeeds.
defaultPrompt: Use $ue5-start-project to route my UE5 game project.
Use $ue5-adapt-story to turn this story into a game plan.
Use $ue5-ingest-project to assess my existing UE5 project.
